REG154.04.STANDARD.lb: UN Regulation No. 154 (WLTP), 04 series of amendments (GRPE working document)

REG154.04.lb: UN Regulation No. 154 (WLTP), 04 series of amendments (GRPE working document)

REG154.04.BODY.lb: Body — Economic Commission for Europe Inland Transport Committee World Forum…
REG154.04.BODY.body: Economic Commission for Europe Inland Transport Committee World Forum for Harmonization of Vehicle Regulations Working Party on Pollution and Energy Ninety third session Geneva, 14-17 October 2025 Item 3(a) of the provisional agenda Light vehicles: UN Regulations Nos. 68 (Measurement of the maximum speed, including electric vehicles), 83 (Emissions of M1 and N1 vehicles), 101 (CO2 emissions/fuel consumption), 103 (Replacement pollution control devices) and 154 (Worldwide harmonized Light vehicles Test Procedures (WLTP)) Proposal for a new Series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 154 (WLTP) Submitted by the experts from the European Commission, Japan, the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland and the International Organization of Motor Vehicle Manufacturers * This document proposes a new 04 series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 154, as a consolidated version. It is a single series which replaces the previous approach for UN Regulation No. 154, which had separate series for the regional levels and the harmonised procedure, which contained the most stringent procedures/limits subject to full mutual recognition. This new series introduces new regional requirements from Contracting Parties, in particular the requirements from Euro 7 in the EU. These include, amongst others, new particle number (PN10) provisions, a new SHED limit for evaporative emissions, updated On-board Fuel Consumption Monitoring provisions, as well as other adaptations to technical progress. It introduces new annexes with requirements relating to in-vehicle battery durability and a new test for range of Pure Electric Vehicles at low temperatures. Economic and Social Council Distr.: General 31 July 2025 Original: English Informal Document GRPE-93-29 Submitted by the experts from the EC, Japan, UK and OICA 93^rd GRPE, 14-17 October 2025 Agenda item 3(a) Updates to GRPE/2025/15e are shown using tracked changes Introduction The intention of this Regulation is to establish uniform provisions concerning the approval of motor vehicles with regard to the emissions of light-duty vehicles based on the new World harmonized Light vehicle Test Procedure (WLTP) included in UN GTR No. 15 and the updated Evaporative Emissions test procedure (Type 4 test) which has been developed in UN GTR No. 19. It will enable Contracting Parties (CPs) to issue and accept approvals based on these new type approval tests. The WLTP Type 1 test replaces both the current Type 1 test in UN Regulation No. 83 and UN Regulation No. 101, whilst the updated Evaporative Emissions test procedure (Type 4 test) replaces that currently in UN Regulation No 83. In addition, this Regulation includes an update to the Type 5 test for verifying the durability of pollution control devices and updated On-Board Diagnostic (OBD) requirements. These updates are in order to reflect the changes from the previous NEDC based Type 1 test to the new WLTP Type 1 test. The 04 series introduces new annexes with requirements relating to in-vehicle battery durability and a new test for range of Pure Electric Vehicles at low temperatures. The 04 series of this Regulation covers three sets of requirements – termed Level 1A, Level 1B and Level 2. Level 1A is based on a four phase test cycle (Low, Medium, High and Extra- High), Level 1B is based on a three phase test cycle (Low, Medium and High), with different type 1 limits applying to these different levels whilst Level 2 includes a harmonised procedure which contains the most stringent procedures/limits which shall be subject to full mutual recognition. The majority of the regulatory text is applicable to all Levels. Where the requirements are specific to either Level 1A, Level 1B or Level 2 the relevant sections are labelled accordingly. Levels 1A and 1B in this series of amendments cover regional requirements and does not require mutual recognition by other Contracting Parties. A type approval to Level 2 in the latest version of this Regulation shall however be accepted by all CPs applying this Regulation.
REG154.04.BODY.foot: In accordance with the programme of work of the Inland Transport Committee for 2025 as outlined in proposed programme budget for 2025 (A/79/6 (Sect. 20), table 20.6), the World Forum will develop, harmonize and update UN Regulations in order to enhance the performance of vehicles. The present document is submitted in conformity with that mandate.

REG154.04.BODY.1.title: Scope
REG154.04.BODY.1.body: This Regulation provides requirements for three levels of approval. One level requires testing using a 4-phase WLTC (low, medium, high and extra-high as defined in Annex B1) – this is called Level 1A. A second level requires testing using a 3-phase WLTC cycle (low, medium and high as defined in Annex B1) – this is called Level 1B. The third level is a harmonised set of requirements and is called Level 2. Where the requirements in this Regulation apply to either Level 1A, Level 1B or Level 2 only, the Regulatory text uses "Level 1A only", "Level 1B only" or “Level 2 only” to denote the start of the level specific requirements.

REG154.04.BODY.1.1.lb: 1.1. Scope for Level 1A; This Regulation applies to the type approval of vehicles of…
REG154.04.BODY.1.1.body: Scope for Level 1A; This Regulation applies to the type approval of vehicles of categories M1 and N1 with regard to the WLTP Type 1 test for emissions of gaseous compounds, particulate matter, particle number and to emissions of carbon dioxide and fuel consumption and/or the measurement of electric energy consumption and electric range and to the Type 4 test on evaporative emissions. In addition, this Regulation lays down rules for verifying the durability of pollution control devices’ On-Board Diagnostic (OBD) systems, On-Board Fuel Consumption Monitoring (OBFCM) devices, battery durability and electric range at low ambient temperatures. At the request of the manufacturer, for vehicles of category N2 between 3.5 and 5 tonnes maximum mass originating from a type of vehicle of category N1, the approval authority may grant an emission type-approval if the vehicle meets the requirements for a type of vehicle of category N1.

REG154.04.BODY.1.2.lb: 1.2. Scope for Level 1B; This Regulation applies to the type approval of vehicles of…
REG154.04.BODY.1.2.body: Scope for Level 1B; This Regulation applies to the type approval of vehicles of categories M2 and N1 with a technical permissible maximum laden mass not exceeding 3,500 kg and to all vehicles of category M1 with regard to the WLTP Type 1 test for emissions of gaseous compounds, particulate matter, particle number and to emissions of carbon dioxide and fuel efficiency and/or the measurement of electric energy consumption and electric range and to the Type 4 test on evaporative emissions. In addition, this Regulation lays down rules for verifying the durability of pollution control devices and On-Board Diagnostic (OBD) systems, On-Board Fuel Consumption Monitoring (OBFCM) devices and battery durability.

REG154.04.BODY.1.3.lb: 1.3. Scope for Level 2; This Regulation applies to the type approval of vehicles of …
REG154.04.BODY.1.3.body: Scope for Level 2; This Regulation applies to the type approval of vehicles of categories M1 and N1 with regard to the WLTP Type 1 test for emissions of gaseous compounds, particulate matter, particle number and to emissions of carbon dioxide and fuel consumption and/or the measurement of electric energy consumption and electric range and to the Type 4 test on evaporative emissions. In addition, this Regulation lays down rules for verifying the durability of pollution control devices, On-Board Diagnostic (OBD) systems, On-Board Fuel Consumption Monitoring (OBFCM) devices, battery durability and electric range at low ambient temperatures.

REG154.04.BODY.3.title: Definitions
REG154.04.BODY.3.body: For the purposes of this Regulation the following definitions shall apply:

REG154.04.BODY.3.0.1.lb: 3.0.1. "Vehicle type with regard to emissions" means a group of vehicles which: (a) Do…
REG154.04.BODY.3.0.1.body: "Vehicle type with regard to emissions" means a group of vehicles which: (a) Do not differ with respect to the criteria constituting an "interpolation family" as defined in paragraph 6.3.2.; (b) Fall in a single "CO2 interpolation range" within the meaning of paragraph 2.3.2. of Annex B6; (c) Do not differ with respect to any characteristics that have a nonnegligible influence on tailpipe emissions, such as, but not limited to, the following: (i) Types and sequence of pollution control devices (e.g. three-way catalyst, oxidation catalyst, lean NOx trap, SCR, lean NOx catalyst, particulate trap or combinations thereof in a single unit); (ii) Exhaust gas recirculation (with or without, internal/external, cooled/non-cooled, low/high/combined pressure).

REG154.04.BODY.3.0.2.lb: 3.0.2. "Engine capacity" means: For reciprocating piston engines, the nominal engine s…
REG154.04.BODY.3.0.2.body: "Engine capacity" means: For reciprocating piston engines, the nominal engine swept volume. For rotary piston engines (Wankel), twice the nominal swept volume of a combustion chamber per piston.

REG154.04.BODY.3.0.3.lb: 3.0.3. "Engine displacement" means: For reciprocating piston engines, the nominal engi…
REG154.04.BODY.3.0.3.body: "Engine displacement" means: For reciprocating piston engines, the nominal engine swept volume. For rotary piston engines (Wankel), the nominal swept volume of a combustion chamber per piston.

REG154.04.BODY.3.0.4.lb: 3.0.4. "Approval of a vehicle" means the approval of a vehicle type with regard to the…
REG154.04.BODY.3.0.4.body: "Approval of a vehicle" means the approval of a vehicle type with regard to the scope of this Regulation.

REG154.04.BODY.3.1.1.lb: 3.1.1. "Accuracy" means the difference between a measured value and a reference value,…
REG154.04.BODY.3.1.1.body: "Accuracy" means the difference between a measured value and a reference value, traceable to a national standard and describes the correctness of a result. See Figure 1.

REG154.04.BODY.3.1.2.lb: 3.1.2. "Calibration" means the process of setting a measurement system's response so t…
REG154.04.BODY.3.1.2.body: "Calibration" means the process of setting a measurement system's response so that its output agrees with a range of reference signals.

REG154.04.BODY.3.1.3.lb: 3.1.3. "Calibration gas" means a gas mixture used to calibrate gas analysers.
REG154.04.BODY.3.1.3.body: "Calibration gas" means a gas mixture used to calibrate gas analysers.

REG154.04.BODY.3.1.4.lb: 3.1.4. "Double dilution method" means the process of separating a part of the diluted …
REG154.04.BODY.3.1.4.body: "Double dilution method" means the process of separating a part of the diluted exhaust flow and mixing it with an appropriate amount of dilution air prior to the particulate sampling filter.

REG154.04.BODY.3.1.5.lb: 3.1.5. "Full flow exhaust dilution system" means the continuous dilution of the total …
REG154.04.BODY.3.1.5.body: "Full flow exhaust dilution system" means the continuous dilution of the total vehicle exhaust with ambient air in a controlled manner using a Constant Volume Sampler (CVS).

REG154.04.BODY.3.1.6.lb: 3.1.6. "Linearization" means the application of a range of concentrations or materials…
REG154.04.BODY.3.1.6.body: "Linearization" means the application of a range of concentrations or materials to establish a mathematical relationship between concentration and system response.

REG154.04.BODY.3.1.7.lb: 3.1.7. "Major maintenance" means the adjustment, repair or replacement of a component …
REG154.04.BODY.3.1.7.body: "Major maintenance" means the adjustment, repair or replacement of a component or module that could affect the accuracy of a measurement.

REG154.04.BODY.3.1.8.lb: 3.1.8. "Non-Methane Hydrocarbons" (NMHC) are the Total Hydrocarbons (THC) minus the me…
REG154.04.BODY.3.1.8.body: "Non-Methane Hydrocarbons" (NMHC) are the Total Hydrocarbons (THC) minus the methane (CH4) contribution.

REG154.04.BODY.3.1.9.lb: 3.1.9. "Precision" means the degree to which repeated measurements under unchanged con…
REG154.04.BODY.3.1.9.body: "Precision" means the degree to which repeated measurements under unchanged conditions show the same results (Figure 1) and, in this Regulation, always refers to one standard deviation.

REG154.04.BODY.3.1.10.lb: 3.1.10. "Reference value" means a value traceable to a national standard. See Figure 1.
REG154.04.BODY.3.1.10.body: "Reference value" means a value traceable to a national standard. See Figure 1.

REG154.04.BODY.3.1.11.lb: 3.1.11. "Set point" means the target value a control system aims to reach.
REG154.04.BODY.3.1.11.body: "Set point" means the target value a control system aims to reach.

REG154.04.BODY.3.1.12.lb: 3.1.12. "Span" means to adjust an instrument so that it gives a proper response to a ca…
REG154.04.BODY.3.1.12.body: "Span" means to adjust an instrument so that it gives a proper response to a calibration standard that represents between 75 per cent and 100 per cent of the maximum value in the instrument range or expected range of use.

REG154.04.BODY.3.1.13.lb: 3.1.13. "Total hydrocarbons" (THC) means all volatile compounds measurable by a flame i…
REG154.04.BODY.3.1.13.body: "Total hydrocarbons" (THC) means all volatile compounds measurable by a flame ionization detector (FID).

REG154.04.BODY.3.1.14.lb: 3.1.14. "Verification" means to evaluate whether or not a measurement system's outputs …
REG154.04.BODY.3.1.14.body: "Verification" means to evaluate whether or not a measurement system's outputs agrees with applied reference signals within one or more predetermined thresholds for acceptance.

REG154.04.BODY.3.1.15.lb: 3.1.15. "Zero gas" means a gas containing no analyte which is used to set a zero respon…
REG154.04.BODY.3.1.15.body: "Zero gas" means a gas containing no analyte which is used to set a zero response on an analyser.

REG154.04.BODY.3.1.16.lb: 3.1.16. "Response time" means the difference in time between the change of the componen…
REG154.04.BODY.3.1.16.body: "Response time" means the difference in time between the change of the component to be measured at the reference point and a system response of 90 per cent of the final reading (t90) with the sampling probe being defined as the reference point, whereby the change of the measured component is at least 60 per cent full scale (FS) and takes place in less than 0.1 second. The system response time consists of the delay time to the system and of the rise time of the system.

REG154.04.BODY.3.1.17.lb: 3.1.17. "Delay time" means the difference in time between the change of the component t…
REG154.04.BODY.3.1.17.body: "Delay time" means the difference in time between the change of the component to be measured at the reference point and a system response of 10 per cent of the final reading (t10) with the sampling probe being defined as the reference point. For gaseous components, this is the transport time of the measured component from the sampling probe to the detector.

REG154.04.BODY.3.1.18.lb: 3.1.18. "Rise time" means the difference in time between the 10 per cent and 90 per cen…
REG154.04.BODY.3.1.18.body: "Rise time" means the difference in time between the 10 per cent and 90 per cent response of the final reading (t_90 – t_10). [FIGURE:REG154.04.BODY.FIG-1]

REG154.04.BODY.3.2.1.lb: 3.2.1. "Aerodynamic drag" means the force opposing a vehicle’s forward motion through …
REG154.04.BODY.3.2.1.body: "Aerodynamic drag" means the force opposing a vehicle’s forward motion through air.

REG154.04.BODY.3.2.2.lb: 3.2.2. "Aerodynamic stagnation point" means the point on the surface of a vehicle wher…
REG154.04.BODY.3.2.2.body: "Aerodynamic stagnation point" means the point on the surface of a vehicle where wind velocity is equal to zero.

REG154.04.BODY.3.2.3.lb: 3.2.3. "Anemometer blockage" means the effect on the anemometer measurement due to the…
REG154.04.BODY.3.2.3.body: "Anemometer blockage" means the effect on the anemometer measurement due to the presence of the vehicle where the apparent air speed is different than the vehicle speed combined with wind speed relative to the ground.

REG154.04.BODY.3.2.4.lb: 3.2.4. "Constrained analysis" means the vehicle’s frontal area and aerodynamic drag co…
REG154.04.BODY.3.2.4.body: "Constrained analysis" means the vehicle’s frontal area and aerodynamic drag coefficient have been independently determined and those values shall be used in the equation of motion.

REG154.04.BODY.3.2.5.lb: 3.2.5. "Mass in running order" means the mass of the vehicle, with its fuel tank(s) fi…
REG154.04.BODY.3.2.5.body: "Mass in running order" means the mass of the vehicle, with its fuel tank(s) filled to at least 90 per cent of its or their capacity/capacities, including the mass of the driver, fuel and liquids, fitted with the standard equipment in accordance with the manufacturer’s specifications and, when they are fitted, the mass of the bodywork, the cabin, the coupling and the spare wheel(s) as well as the tools.

REG154.04.BODY.3.2.6.lb: 3.2.6. "Mass of the driver" means a mass rated at 75 kg located at the driver’s seatin…
REG154.04.BODY.3.2.6.body: "Mass of the driver" means a mass rated at 75 kg located at the driver’s seating reference point.

REG154.04.BODY.3.2.7.lb: 3.2.7. "Maximum vehicle load" means the technically permissible maximum laden mass min…
REG154.04.BODY.3.2.7.body: "Maximum vehicle load" means the technically permissible maximum laden mass minus the mass in running order, 25 kg and the mass of the optional equipment as defined in paragraph 3.2.8.

REG154.04.BODY.3.2.8.lb: 3.2.8. "Mass of the optional equipment" means maximum mass of the combinations of opti…
REG154.04.BODY.3.2.8.body: "Mass of the optional equipment" means maximum mass of the combinations of optional equipment which may be fitted to the vehicle in addition to the standard equipment in accordance with the manufacturer's specifications.

REG154.04.BODY.3.2.9.lb: 3.2.9. "Optional equipment" means all the features not included in the standard equipm…
REG154.04.BODY.3.2.9.body: "Optional equipment" means all the features not included in the standard equipment which are fitted to a vehicle under the responsibility of the manufacturer, and that can be ordered by the customer.

REG154.04.BODY.3.2.10.lb: 3.2.10. "Reference atmospheric conditions (regarding road load measurements)" means the…
REG154.04.BODY.3.2.10.body: "Reference atmospheric conditions (regarding road load measurements)" means the atmospheric conditions to which these measurement results are corrected: (a) Atmospheric pressure: p_0 = 100 kPa; (b) Atmospheric temperature: T0 = 20 °C; (c) Dry air density: ρ_0 = 1.189 kg/m; (d) Wind speed: 0 m/s.

REG154.04.BODY.3.2.11.lb: 3.2.11. "Reference speed" means the vehicle speed at which road load is determined or c…
REG154.04.BODY.3.2.11.body: "Reference speed" means the vehicle speed at which road load is determined or chassis dynamometer load is verified.

REG154.04.BODY.3.2.12.lb: 3.2.12. "Road load" means the force resisting the forward motion of a vehicle as measur…
REG154.04.BODY.3.2.12.body: "Road load" means the force resisting the forward motion of a vehicle as measured with the coastdown method or methods that are equivalent regarding the inclusion of frictional losses of the drivetrain.

REG154.04.BODY.3.2.13.lb: 3.2.13. "Rolling resistance" means the forces of the tyres opposing the motion of a veh…
REG154.04.BODY.3.2.13.body: "Rolling resistance" means the forces of the tyres opposing the motion of a vehicle.

REG154.04.BODY.3.2.14.lb: 3.2.14. "Running resistance" means the torque resisting the forward motion of a vehicle…
REG154.04.BODY.3.2.14.body: "Running resistance" means the torque resisting the forward motion of a vehicle measured by torque meters installed at the driven wheels of a vehicle.

REG154.04.BODY.3.2.15.lb: 3.2.15. "Simulated road load" means the road load experienced by the vehicle on the cha…
REG154.04.BODY.3.2.15.body: "Simulated road load" means the road load experienced by the vehicle on the chassis dynamometer which is intended to reproduce the road load measured on the road, and consists of the force applied by the chassis dynamometer and the forces resisting the vehicle while driving on the chassis dynamometer and is approximated by the three coefficients of a second order polynomial.

REG154.04.BODY.3.2.16.lb: 3.2.16. "Simulated running resistance" means the running resistance experienced by the …
REG154.04.BODY.3.2.16.body: "Simulated running resistance" means the running resistance experienced by the vehicle on the chassis dynamometer which is intended to reproduce the running resistance measured on the road, and consists of the torque applied by the chassis dynamometer and the torque resisting the vehicle while driving on the chassis dynamometer and is approximated by the three coefficients of a second order polynomial.

REG154.04.BODY.3.2.17.lb: 3.2.17. "Stationary anemometry" means measurement of wind speed and direction with an a…
REG154.04.BODY.3.2.17.body: "Stationary anemometry" means measurement of wind speed and direction with an anemometer at a location and height above road level alongside the test road where the most representative wind conditions will be experienced.

REG154.04.BODY.3.2.18.lb: 3.2.18. "Standard equipment" means the basic configuration of a vehicle which is equipp…
REG154.04.BODY.3.2.18.body: "Standard equipment" means the basic configuration of a vehicle which is equipped with all the features that are required under the regulatory acts of the Contracting Party including all features that are fitted without giving rise to any further specifications on configuration or equipment level.

REG154.04.BODY.3.2.19.lb: 3.2.19. "Target road load" means the road load to be reproduced on the chassis dynamome…
REG154.04.BODY.3.2.19.body: "Target road load" means the road load to be reproduced on the chassis dynamometer.

REG154.04.BODY.3.2.20.lb: 3.2.20. "Target running resistance" means the running resistance to be reproduced.
REG154.04.BODY.3.2.20.body: "Target running resistance" means the running resistance to be reproduced.

REG154.04.BODY.3.2.21.lb: 3.2.21. "Vehicle coastdown mode" means a system of operation enabling an accurate and r…
REG154.04.BODY.3.2.21.body: "Vehicle coastdown mode" means a system of operation enabling an accurate and repeatable determination of road load and an accurate dynamometer setting.

REG154.04.BODY.3.2.22.lb: 3.2.22. "Wind correction" means correction of the effect of wind on road load based on …
REG154.04.BODY.3.2.22.body: "Wind correction" means correction of the effect of wind on road load based on input of the stationary or on-board anemometry.

REG154.04.BODY.3.2.23.lb: 3.2.23. "Technically permissible maximum laden mass" means the maximum mass allocated t…
REG154.04.BODY.3.2.23.body: "Technically permissible maximum laden mass" means the maximum mass allocated to a vehicle on the basis of its construction features and its design performances.

REG154.04.BODY.3.2.24.lb: 3.2.24. "Actual mass of the vehicle" means the mass in running order plus the mass of t…
REG154.04.BODY.3.2.24.body: "Actual mass of the vehicle" means the mass in running order plus the mass of the fitted optional equipment to an individual vehicle.

REG154.04.BODY.3.2.25.lb: 3.2.25. "Test mass of the vehicle" means the sum of the actual mass of the vehicle, 25 …
REG154.04.BODY.3.2.25.body: "Test mass of the vehicle" means the sum of the actual mass of the vehicle, 25 kg and the mass representative of the vehicle load.

REG154.04.BODY.3.2.26.lb: 3.2.26. "Mass representative of the vehicle load" means x per cent of the maximum vehic…
REG154.04.BODY.3.2.26.body: "Mass representative of the vehicle load" means x per cent of the maximum vehicle load where x is 15 per cent for category M vehicles and 28 per cent for category N vehicles.

REG154.04.BODY.3.2.27.lb: 3.2.27. "Technically permissible maximum laden mass of the combination" (MC) means the …
REG154.04.BODY.3.2.27.body: "Technically permissible maximum laden mass of the combination" (MC) means the maximum mass allocated to the combination of a motor vehicle and one or more trailers on the basis of its construction features and its design performances or the maximum mass allocated to the combination of a tractor unit and a semi-trailer.

REG154.04.BODY.3.2.28.lb: 3.2.28. "n/v ratio" means the engine rotational speed divided by vehicle speed.
REG154.04.BODY.3.2.28.body: "n/v ratio" means the engine rotational speed divided by vehicle speed.

REG154.04.BODY.3.2.29.lb: 3.2.29. "Single roller dynamometer" means a dynamometer where each wheel on a vehicle's…
REG154.04.BODY.3.2.29.body: "Single roller dynamometer" means a dynamometer where each wheel on a vehicle's axle is in contact with one roller.

REG154.04.BODY.3.2.30.lb: 3.2.30. "Twin-roller dynamometer" means a dynamometer where each wheel on a vehicle's a…
REG154.04.BODY.3.2.30.body: "Twin-roller dynamometer" means a dynamometer where each wheel on a vehicle's axle is in contact with two rollers.

REG154.04.BODY.3.2.31.lb: 3.2.31. "Powered axle" means an axle of a vehicle which is able to deliver propulsion e…
REG154.04.BODY.3.2.31.body: "Powered axle" means an axle of a vehicle which is able to deliver propulsion energy and/or recuperate energy, independent of whether that is only temporarily or permanently possible and/or selectable by the driver.

REG154.04.BODY.3.2.32.lb: 3.2.32. "2WD dynamometer" means a dynamometer where only the wheels on one vehicle axle…
REG154.04.BODY.3.2.32.body: "2WD dynamometer" means a dynamometer where only the wheels on one vehicle axle are in contact with the roller(s).

REG154.04.BODY.3.2.33.lb: 3.2.33. "4WD dynamometer" means a dynamometer where all wheels on both vehicle axles ar…
REG154.04.BODY.3.2.33.body: "4WD dynamometer" means a dynamometer where all wheels on both vehicle axles are in contact with the rollers.

REG154.04.BODY.3.2.34.lb: 3.2.34. "Dynamometer in 2WD operation" means a 2WD dynamometer, or a 4WD dynamometer wh…
REG154.04.BODY.3.2.34.body: "Dynamometer in 2WD operation" means a 2WD dynamometer, or a 4WD dynamometer which only simulates inertia and road load on the powered axle of the test vehicle and where the rotating wheels on the non-powered axle shall have no influence on the measurement results compared to a situation where the wheels on the non-powered axle are not rotating.

REG154.04.BODY.3.2.35.lb: 3.2.35. "Dynamometer in 4WD operation" means a 4WD dynamometer which simulates inertia …
REG154.04.BODY.3.2.35.body: "Dynamometer in 4WD operation" means a 4WD dynamometer which simulates inertia and road load on both axles of the test vehicle.

REG154.04.BODY.3.2.36.lb: 3.2.36. "Coasting" means a functionality of either an automatic transmission or a clutc…
REG154.04.BODY.3.2.36.body: "Coasting" means a functionality of either an automatic transmission or a clutch which, when no propulsion or a slow reduction of speed is needed, decouples the engine from the drivetrain automatically and neither a propulsion energy is applied to the wheels nor recuperation energy is taken from the wheels nor friction braking is applied. During application of this function the engine may be idling or switched off.

REG154.04.BODY.3.2.37.lb: 3.2.37. "Reference mass" means the vehicle’s mass in running order less the uniform mas…
REG154.04.BODY.3.2.37.body: "Reference mass" means the vehicle’s mass in running order less the uniform mass of the driver of 75 kg and increased by a uniform mass of 100 kg.

REG154.04.BODY.3.3.lb: 3.3. Pure electric, pure ICE, hybrid electric, fuel cell and alternatively-fuelled v…
REG154.04.BODY.3.3.body: Pure electric, pure ICE, hybrid electric, fuel cell and alternatively-fuelled vehicles

REG154.04.BODY.3.3.1.lb: 3.3.1. "All-Electric Range" (AER) means the total distance travelled by an OVC- HEV fr…
REG154.04.BODY.3.3.1.body: "All-Electric Range" (AER) means the total distance travelled by an OVC- HEV from the beginning of the charge-depleting test to the point in time during the test when the combustion engine starts to consume fuel.

REG154.04.BODY.3.3.2.lb: 3.3.2. "Pure Electric Range" (PER) means the total distance travelled by a PEV from th…
REG154.04.BODY.3.3.2.body: "Pure Electric Range" (PER) means the total distance travelled by a PEV from the beginning of the charge-depleting test until the break-off criterion is reached.

REG154.04.BODY.3.3.3.lb: 3.3.3. "Charge-Depleting Actual Range" (RCDA) means the distance travelled in a series…
REG154.04.BODY.3.3.3.body: "Charge-Depleting Actual Range" (RCDA) means the distance travelled in a series of WLTCs in charge-depleting operating condition until the Rechargeable Electric Energy Storage System (REESS) is depleted.

REG154.04.BODY.3.3.4.lb: 3.3.4. "Charge-Depleting Cycle Range" (RCDC) means the distance from the beginning of …
REG154.04.BODY.3.3.4.body: "Charge-Depleting Cycle Range" (RCDC) means the distance from the beginning of the charge-depleting test to the end of the last cycle prior to the cycle or cycles satisfying the break-off criterion, including the transition cycle where the vehicle may have operated in both depleting and sustaining conditions.

REG154.04.BODY.3.3.5.lb: 3.3.5. "Charge-depleting operating condition" means an operating condition in which th…
REG154.04.BODY.3.3.5.body: "Charge-depleting operating condition" means an operating condition in which the energy stored in the REESS may fluctuate but decreases on average while the vehicle is driven until transition to charge-sustaining operation.

REG154.04.BODY.3.3.6.lb: 3.3.6. "Charge-sustaining operating condition" means an operating condition in which t…
REG154.04.BODY.3.3.6.body: "Charge-sustaining operating condition" means an operating condition in which the energy stored in the REESS may fluctuate but, on average, is maintained at a neutral charging balance level while the vehicle is driven.

REG154.04.BODY.3.3.7.lb: 3.3.7. "Utility Factors" are ratios based on driving statistics depending on the range…
REG154.04.BODY.3.3.7.body: "Utility Factors" are ratios based on driving statistics depending on the range achieved in charge-depleting condition and are used to weigh the chargedepleting and charge-sustaining exhaust emission compounds, CO2 emissions and fuel consumption for OVC-HEVs.

REG154.04.BODY.3.3.8.lb: 3.3.8. "Electric machine" (EM) means an energy converter transforming between electric…
REG154.04.BODY.3.3.8.body: "Electric machine" (EM) means an energy converter transforming between electrical and mechanical energy.

REG154.04.BODY.3.3.9.lb: 3.3.9. "Energy converter" means a system where the form of energy output is different …
REG154.04.BODY.3.3.9.body: "Energy converter" means a system where the form of energy output is different from the form of energy input.

REG154.04.BODY.3.3.9.1.lb: 3.3.9.1. "Propulsion energy converter" means an energy converter of the powertrain which…
REG154.04.BODY.3.3.9.1.body: "Propulsion energy converter" means an energy converter of the powertrain which is not a peripheral device whose output energy is used directly or indirectly for the purpose of vehicle propulsion.

REG154.04.BODY.3.3.9.2.lb: 3.3.9.2. "Category of propulsion energy converter" means (i) an internal combustion engi…
REG154.04.BODY.3.3.9.2.body: "Category of propulsion energy converter" means (i) an internal combustion engine, or (ii) an electric machine, or (iii) a fuel cell.

REG154.04.BODY.3.3.10.lb: 3.3.10. "Energy storage system" means a system which stores energy and releases it in t…
REG154.04.BODY.3.3.10.body: "Energy storage system" means a system which stores energy and releases it in the same form as was input.

REG154.04.BODY.3.3.10.1.lb: 3.3.10.1. "Propulsion energy storage system" means an energy storage system of the powert…
REG154.04.BODY.3.3.10.1.body: "Propulsion energy storage system" means an energy storage system of the powertrain which is not a peripheral device and whose output energy is used directly or indirectly for the purpose of vehicle propulsion.

REG154.04.BODY.3.3.10.2.lb: 3.3.10.2. "Category of propulsion energy storage system" means (i) a fuel storage system,…
REG154.04.BODY.3.3.10.2.body: "Category of propulsion energy storage system" means (i) a fuel storage system, or (ii) a rechargeable electric energy storage system, or (iii) a rechargeable mechanical energy storage system.

REG154.04.BODY.3.3.10.3.lb: 3.3.10.3. "Form of energy" means (i) electrical energy, or (ii) mechanical energy, or (ii…
REG154.04.BODY.3.3.10.3.body: "Form of energy" means (i) electrical energy, or (ii) mechanical energy, or (iii) chemical energy (including fuels).

REG154.04.BODY.3.3.10.4.lb: 3.3.10.4. "Fuel storage system" means a propulsion energy storage system that stores chem…
REG154.04.BODY.3.3.10.4.body: "Fuel storage system" means a propulsion energy storage system that stores chemical energy as liquid or gaseous fuel.

REG154.04.BODY.3.3.11.lb: 3.3.11. "Equivalent all-electric range" (EAER) means that portion of the total chargede…
REG154.04.BODY.3.3.11.body: "Equivalent all-electric range" (EAER) means that portion of the total chargedepleting actual range (RCDA) attributable to the use of electricity from the REESS over the charge-depleting range test.

REG154.04.BODY.3.3.12.lb: 3.3.12. "Hybrid electric vehicle" (HEV) means a hybrid vehicle where one of the propuls…
REG154.04.BODY.3.3.12.body: "Hybrid electric vehicle" (HEV) means a hybrid vehicle where one of the propulsion energy converters is an electric machine.

REG154.04.BODY.3.3.13.lb: 3.3.13. "Hybrid vehicle" (HV) means a vehicle equipped with a powertrain containing at …
REG154.04.BODY.3.3.13.body: "Hybrid vehicle" (HV) means a vehicle equipped with a powertrain containing at least two different categories of propulsion energy converters and at least two different categories of propulsion energy storage systems.

REG154.04.BODY.3.3.14.lb: 3.3.14. "Net energy change" means the ratio of the REESS energy change divided by the c…
REG154.04.BODY.3.3.14.body: "Net energy change" means the ratio of the REESS energy change divided by the cycle energy demand of the test vehicle.

REG154.04.BODY.3.3.15.lb: 3.3.15. "Not off-vehicle charging hybrid electric vehicle" (NOVC-HEV) means a hybrid el…
REG154.04.BODY.3.3.15.body: "Not off-vehicle charging hybrid electric vehicle" (NOVC-HEV) means a hybrid electric vehicle that cannot be charged from an external source.

REG154.04.BODY.3.3.16.lb: 3.3.16. "Off-vehicle charging hybrid electric vehicle" (OVC-HEV) means a hybrid electri…
REG154.04.BODY.3.3.16.body: "Off-vehicle charging hybrid electric vehicle" (OVC-HEV) means a hybrid electric vehicle that can be charged from an external source.

REG154.04.BODY.3.3.17.lb: 3.3.17. "Pure electric vehicle" (PEV) means a vehicle equipped with a powertrain contai…
REG154.04.BODY.3.3.17.body: "Pure electric vehicle" (PEV) means a vehicle equipped with a powertrain containing exclusively electric machines as propulsion energy converters and exclusively rechargeable electric energy storage systems as propulsion energy storage systems.

REG154.04.BODY.3.3.18.lb: 3.3.18. "Fuel cell" means an energy converter transforming chemical energy (input) into…
REG154.04.BODY.3.3.18.body: "Fuel cell" means an energy converter transforming chemical energy (input) into electrical energy (output) or vice versa.

REG154.04.BODY.3.3.19.lb: 3.3.19. "Fuel cell vehicle" (FCV) means a vehicle equipped with a powertrain containing…
REG154.04.BODY.3.3.19.body: "Fuel cell vehicle" (FCV) means a vehicle equipped with a powertrain containing exclusively fuel cell(s) and electric machine(s) as propulsion energy converter(s).

REG154.04.BODY.3.3.20.lb: 3.3.20. "Fuel cell hybrid vehicle" (FCHV) means a fuel cell vehicle equipped with a pow…
REG154.04.BODY.3.3.20.body: "Fuel cell hybrid vehicle" (FCHV) means a fuel cell vehicle equipped with a powertrain containing at least one fuel storage system and at least one rechargeable electric energy storage system as propulsion energy storage systems.

REG154.04.BODY.3.3.20.1.lb: 3.3.20.1. "Not off-vehicle charging fuel cell hybrid electric vehicle" (NOVC-FCHV) means …
REG154.04.BODY.3.3.20.1.body: "Not off-vehicle charging fuel cell hybrid electric vehicle" (NOVC-FCHV) means a fuel cell hybrid electric vehicle that cannot be charged from an external source.

REG154.04.BODY.3.3.20.2.lb: 3.3.20.2. "Off-vehicle charging fuel cell hybrid electric vehicle" (OVC-FCHV) means a fue…
REG154.04.BODY.3.3.20.2.body: "Off-vehicle charging fuel cell hybrid electric vehicle" (OVC-FCHV) means a fuel cell hybrid electric vehicle that can be charged from an external source.

REG154.04.BODY.3.3.21.lb: 3.3.21. "Bi-fuel vehicle" means a vehicle with two separate fuel storage systems that i…
REG154.04.BODY.3.3.21.body: "Bi-fuel vehicle" means a vehicle with two separate fuel storage systems that is designed to run primarily on only one fuel at a time; however, the simultaneous use of both fuels is permitted in limited amount and duration.

REG154.04.BODY.3.3.22.lb: 3.3.22. "Bi-fuel gas vehicle" means a bi-fuel vehicle where the two fuels are petrol (p…
REG154.04.BODY.3.3.22.body: "Bi-fuel gas vehicle" means a bi-fuel vehicle where the two fuels are petrol (petrol mode) and either LPG, NG/biomethane, or hydrogen.

REG154.04.BODY.3.3.23.lb: 3.3.23. "Pure ICE vehicle" means a vehicle where all of the propulsion energy converter…
REG154.04.BODY.3.3.23.body: "Pure ICE vehicle" means a vehicle where all of the propulsion energy converters are internal combustion engines.

REG154.04.BODY.3.3.24.lb: 3.3.24. "On-board charger" means the electric power converter between the traction REES…
REG154.04.BODY.3.3.24.body: "On-board charger" means the electric power converter between the traction REESS and the vehicle's recharging socket.

REG154.04.BODY.3.3.25.lb: 3.3.25. "Flex fuel vehicle" means a vehicle with one fuel storage system that can run o…
REG154.04.BODY.3.3.25.body: "Flex fuel vehicle" means a vehicle with one fuel storage system that can run on different mixtures of two or more fuels.

REG154.04.BODY.3.3.26.lb: 3.3.26. "Flex fuel ethanol vehicle" means a flex fuel vehicle that can run on petrol or…
REG154.04.BODY.3.3.26.body: "Flex fuel ethanol vehicle" means a flex fuel vehicle that can run on petrol or a mixture of petrol and ethanol up to an 85 per cent ethanol blend (E85).

REG154.04.BODY.3.3.27.lb: 3.3.27. "Mono-fuel vehicle" means a vehicle that is designed to run primarily on one ty…
REG154.04.BODY.3.3.27.body: "Mono-fuel vehicle" means a vehicle that is designed to run primarily on one type of fuel.

REG154.04.BODY.3.3.28.lb: 3.3.28. "Mono-fuel gas vehicle" means a mono-fuel vehicle that is designed primarily fo…
REG154.04.BODY.3.3.28.body: "Mono-fuel gas vehicle" means a mono-fuel vehicle that is designed primarily for permanent running on LPG or NG/biomethane or hydrogen, but may also have a petrol system for emergency purposes or starting only, where the nominal capacity of the petrol tank does not exceed 15 litres.

REG154.04.BODY.3.4.1.lb: 3.4.1. "Powertrain" means the total combination in a vehicle of propulsion energy stor…
REG154.04.BODY.3.4.1.body: "Powertrain" means the total combination in a vehicle of propulsion energy storage system(s), propulsion energy converter(s) and the drivetrain(s) providing the mechanical energy at the wheels for the purpose of vehicle propulsion, plus peripheral devices.

REG154.04.BODY.3.4.2.lb: 3.4.2. "Auxiliary devices" means energy consuming, converting, storing or supplying no…
REG154.04.BODY.3.4.2.body: "Auxiliary devices" means energy consuming, converting, storing or supplying non-peripheral devices or systems which are installed in the vehicle for purposes other than the propulsion of the vehicle and are therefore not considered to be part of the powertrain.

REG154.04.BODY.3.4.3.lb: 3.4.3. "Peripheral devices" means any energy consuming, converting, storing or supplyi…
REG154.04.BODY.3.4.3.body: "Peripheral devices" means any energy consuming, converting, storing or supplying devices, where the energy is not directly or indirectly used for the purpose of vehicle propulsion but which are essential to the operation of the powertrain and are therefore considered to be part of the powertrain.

REG154.04.BODY.3.4.4.lb: 3.4.4. "Drivetrain" means the connected elements of the powertrain for transmission of…
REG154.04.BODY.3.4.4.body: "Drivetrain" means the connected elements of the powertrain for transmission of the mechanical energy between the propulsion energy converter(s) and the wheels.

REG154.04.BODY.3.4.5.lb: 3.4.5. "Manual transmission" means a transmission where gears can only be shifted by a…
REG154.04.BODY.3.4.5.body: "Manual transmission" means a transmission where gears can only be shifted by action of the driver.

REG154.04.BODY.3.5.1.lb: 3.5.1. "Criteria emissions" means those emission compounds for which limits are set in…
REG154.04.BODY.3.5.1.body: "Criteria emissions" means those emission compounds for which limits are set in this Regulation.

REG154.04.BODY.3.5.5.lb: 3.5.5. "Cycle energy demand REESS (CEDREESS)" means the calculated positive and negati…
REG154.04.BODY.3.5.5.body: "Cycle energy demand REESS (CEDREESS)" means the calculated positive and negative energy required by the vehicle REESS to drive the prescribed cycle.

REG154.04.BODY.3.5.6.lb: 3.5.6. "Cycle energy demand" means the calculated positive energy required by the vehi…
REG154.04.BODY.3.5.6.body: "Cycle energy demand" means the calculated positive energy required by the vehicle to drive the prescribed cycle.

REG154.04.BODY.3.5.7.lb: 3.5.7. This paragraph is applicable to Level 1B and Level 2 only
REG154.04.BODY.3.5.7.title: This paragraph is applicable to Level 1B and Level 2 only
REG154.04.BODY.3.5.7.body: "Defeat device" means any element of design which senses temperature, vehicle speed, engine speed (RPM), transmission gear, manifold vacuum or any other parameter for the purpose of activating, modulating, delaying or deactivating the operation of any part of the emission control system, that reduces the effectiveness of the emission control system under conditions which may reasonably be expected to be encountered in normal vehicle operation and use.

REG154.04.BODY.3.5.8.lb: 3.5.8. "Driver-selectable mode" means a distinct driver-selectable condition which cou…
REG154.04.BODY.3.5.8.body: "Driver-selectable mode" means a distinct driver-selectable condition which could affect emissions, or fuel and/or energy consumption.

REG154.04.BODY.3.5.9.lb: 3.5.9. "Predominant mode" for the purpose of this Regulation means a single driversele…
REG154.04.BODY.3.5.9.body: "Predominant mode" for the purpose of this Regulation means a single driverselectable mode that is always selected when the vehicle is switched on, regardless of the driver-selectable mode in operation when the vehicle was previously shut down, and which cannot be redefined to another mode. After the vehicle is switched on, the predominant mode can only be switched to another driver-selectable mode by an intentional action of the driver.

REG154.04.BODY.3.5.10.lb: 3.5.10. "Reference conditions (with regards to calculating mass emissions)" means the c…
REG154.04.BODY.3.5.10.body: "Reference conditions (with regards to calculating mass emissions)" means the conditions upon which gas densities are based, namely 101.325 kPa and 273.15 K (0 °C).

REG154.04.BODY.3.5.11.lb: 3.5.11. "Exhaust emissions" means the emission of gaseous, solid and liquid compounds f…
REG154.04.BODY.3.5.11.body: "Exhaust emissions" means the emission of gaseous, solid and liquid compounds from the tailpipe.

REG154.04.BODY.3.5.12.lb: 3.5.12. "Configurable start mode" for the purpose of this Regulation means a driversele…
REG154.04.BODY.3.5.12.body: "Configurable start mode" for the purpose of this Regulation means a driverselectable mode that can be set by the driver as a mode which is automatically selected when the vehicle is switched on. After the vehicle is switched on, the configurable start mode can only be switched to another mode by an intentional action of the driver.

REG154.04.BODY.3.6.title: PM/PN
REG154.04.BODY.3.6.body: The term "particle" is conventionally used for the matter being characterised (measured) in the airborne phase (suspended matter), and the term "particulate" for the deposited matter.

REG154.04.BODY.3.6.1.lb: 3.6.1. "Particle number emissions" (PN) means the total number of solid particles emit…
REG154.04.BODY.3.6.1.body: "Particle number emissions" (PN) means the total number of solid particles emitted from the vehicle exhaust quantified according to the dilution, sampling and measurement methods as specified in this Regulation.

REG154.04.BODY.3.6.2.lb: 3.6.2. "Particulate matter emissions" (PM) means the mass of any particulate material …
REG154.04.BODY.3.6.2.body: "Particulate matter emissions" (PM) means the mass of any particulate material from the vehicle exhaust quantified according to the dilution, sampling and measurement methods as specified in this Regulation.

REG154.04.BODY.3.7.1.lb: 3.7.1. "Rated engine power" (P_rated) means maximum net power of the engine or motor i…
REG154.04.BODY.3.7.1.body: "Rated engine power" (P_rated) means maximum net power of the engine or motor in kW as per the requirements of UN Regulation No. 85 or system power as per the requirement of UN Regulation No. 177 if applicable.

REG154.04.BODY.3.7.2.lb: 3.7.2. "Maximum speed" (v_max) means the maximum speed of a vehicle as declared by the…
REG154.04.BODY.3.7.2.body: "Maximum speed" (v_max) means the maximum speed of a vehicle as declared by the manufacturer. In the absence of a declaration, the maximum speed shall be determined according to UN Regulation No. 68.

REG154.04.BODY.3.8.1.lb: 3.8.1. "Periodically regenerating system" means an exhaust emissions control device (e…
REG154.04.BODY.3.8.1.body: "Periodically regenerating system" means an exhaust emissions control device (e.g. catalytic converter, particulate trap) that requires a periodical regeneration.

REG154.04.BODY.3.9.1.lb: 3.9.1. "Fuel tank system" means the devices which allow storing the fuel, comprising t…
REG154.04.BODY.3.9.1.body: "Fuel tank system" means the devices which allow storing the fuel, comprising the fuel tank, the fuel filler, the filler cap and the fuel pump when it is fitted in or on the fuel tank.

REG154.04.BODY.3.9.2.lb: 3.9.2. "Fuel system" means the components which store or transport fuel on board the v…
REG154.04.BODY.3.9.2.body: "Fuel system" means the components which store or transport fuel on board the vehicle and comprise the fuel tank system, all fuel and vapour lines, any non-tank mounted fuel pumps and the activated carbon canister.

REG154.04.BODY.3.9.3.lb: 3.9.3. "Butane working capacity" (BWC) means the mass of butane which a carbon caniste…
REG154.04.BODY.3.9.3.body: "Butane working capacity" (BWC) means the mass of butane which a carbon canister can adsorb.

REG154.04.BODY.3.9.4.lb: 3.9.4. "BWC300" means the butane working capacity after 300 cycles of fuel ageing cycl…
REG154.04.BODY.3.9.4.body: "BWC300" means the butane working capacity after 300 cycles of fuel ageing cycles experienced.

REG154.04.BODY.3.9.5.lb: 3.9.5. "Permeability Factor" (PF) means the factor determined from hydrocarbon losses …
REG154.04.BODY.3.9.5.body: "Permeability Factor" (PF) means the factor determined from hydrocarbon losses over a period of time and used to determine the final evaporative emissions.

REG154.04.BODY.3.9.6.lb: 3.9.6. "Monolayer non-metal tank" means a fuel tank constructed with a single layer of…
REG154.04.BODY.3.9.6.body: "Monolayer non-metal tank" means a fuel tank constructed with a single layer of non-metal material including fluorinated/sulfonated materials.

REG154.04.BODY.3.9.7.lb: 3.9.7. "Multilayer tank" means a fuel tank constructed with at least two different lay…
REG154.04.BODY.3.9.7.body: "Multilayer tank" means a fuel tank constructed with at least two different layered materials, one of which is a hydrocarbon barrier material.

REG154.04.BODY.3.9.8.lb: 3.9.8. "Sealed fuel tank system" means a fuel tank system where the fuel vapours do no…
REG154.04.BODY.3.9.8.body: "Sealed fuel tank system" means a fuel tank system where the fuel vapours do not vent during parking over the 24-hour diurnal cycle defined in paragraph 6.5.9. of Annex C3 when performed with the applicable reference fuel defined in paragraph 7 of Annex B3.

REG154.04.BODY.3.9.9.lb: 3.9.9. "Evaporative emissions" means in the context of this Regulation the hydrocarbon…
REG154.04.BODY.3.9.9.body: "Evaporative emissions" means in the context of this Regulation the hydrocarbon vapours lost from the fuel system of a motor vehicle during parking and immediately before refuelling of a sealed fuel tank.

REG154.04.BODY.3.9.10.lb: 3.9.10. "Depressurisation puff loss" means hydrocarbons venting from a sealed fuel tank…
REG154.04.BODY.3.9.10.body: "Depressurisation puff loss" means hydrocarbons venting from a sealed fuel tank system pressure relief exclusively through the carbon canister allowed by the system.

REG154.04.BODY.3.9.11.lb: 3.9.11. "Depressurisation puff loss overflow" are the depressurisation puff loss hydroc…
REG154.04.BODY.3.9.11.body: "Depressurisation puff loss overflow" are the depressurisation puff loss hydrocarbons that pass through the carbon canister during depressurisation.

REG154.04.BODY.3.9.12.lb: 3.9.12. "Fuel tank relief pressure" is the minimum pressure value at which the sealed f…
REG154.04.BODY.3.9.12.body: "Fuel tank relief pressure" is the minimum pressure value at which the sealed fuel tank system starts venting in response only to pressure inside the tank.

REG154.04.BODY.3.9.13.lb: 3.9.13. "2 gram breakthrough" shall be considered accomplished when the cumulative quan…
REG154.04.BODY.3.9.13.body: "2 gram breakthrough" shall be considered accomplished when the cumulative quantity of hydrocarbons emitted from the activated carbon canister equals 2 grams.

REG154.04.BODY.3.10.1.lb: 3.10.1. "On-Board Diagnostic (OBD) system" means in context of this Regulation, a syste…
REG154.04.BODY.3.10.1.body: "On-Board Diagnostic (OBD) system" means in context of this Regulation, a system on-board the vehicle which has the capability of detecting malfunctions of the monitored emission control systems, identifying the likely area of a malfunction by means of fault codes stored in computer memory, and illumination of the Malfunction Indicator (MI) to notify the operator of the vehicle.

REG154.04.BODY.3.10.2.lb: 3.10.2. "OBD family" means a manufacturer's grouping of vehicles which, through their d…
REG154.04.BODY.3.10.2.body: "OBD family" means a manufacturer's grouping of vehicles which, through their design, are expected to have similar exhaust emission and OBD system characteristics. Each vehicle of this family shall have complied with the requirements of this Regulation as defined in paragraph 6.8.1.

REG154.04.BODY.3.10.3.lb: 3.10.3. "Emission control system" means in the context of OBD the electronic engine man…
REG154.04.BODY.3.10.3.body: "Emission control system" means in the context of OBD the electronic engine management controller and any emission-related component in the exhaust or evaporative system which supplies an input to or receives an output from this controller.

REG154.04.BODY.3.10.4.lb: 3.10.4. "Malfunction indicator (MI)" means a visible or audible indicator that clearly …
REG154.04.BODY.3.10.4.body: "Malfunction indicator (MI)" means a visible or audible indicator that clearly informs the driver of the vehicle in the event of a malfunction of any emissionrelated component connected to the OBD system, or the OBD system itself.

REG154.04.BODY.3.10.5.lb: 3.10.5. "Malfunction" means the failure of an emission-related component or system that…
REG154.04.BODY.3.10.5.body: "Malfunction" means the failure of an emission-related component or system that would result in emissions exceeding the OBD thresholds in paragraph 6.8.2. or if the OBD system is unable to fulfil the basic monitoring requirements of Annex C5.

REG154.04.BODY.3.10.6.lb: 3.10.6. "Secondary air" refers to air introduced into the exhaust system by means of a …
REG154.04.BODY.3.10.6.body: "Secondary air" refers to air introduced into the exhaust system by means of a pump or aspirator valve or other means that is intended to aid in the oxidation of HC and CO contained in the exhaust gas stream.

REG154.04.BODY.3.10.7.lb: 3.10.7. "Engine misfire" means lack of combustion in the cylinder of a positive ignitio…
REG154.04.BODY.3.10.7.body: "Engine misfire" means lack of combustion in the cylinder of a positive ignition engine due to absence of spark, poor fuel metering, poor compression or any other cause. In terms of OBD monitoring it is that percentage of misfires out of a total number of firing events (as declared by the manufacturer) that would result in emissions exceeding the OBD thresholds given in paragraph 6.8.2. or that percentage that could lead to an exhaust catalyst, or catalysts, overheating causing irreversible damage.

REG154.04.BODY.3.10.8.lb: 3.10.8. An "OBD driving cycle" consists of key-on, a driving mode where a malfunction w…
REG154.04.BODY.3.10.8.body: An "OBD driving cycle" consists of key-on, a driving mode where a malfunction would be detected if present, and key-off.

REG154.04.BODY.3.10.9.lb: 3.10.9. A "warm-up cycle" means sufficient vehicle operation such that the coolant temp…
REG154.04.BODY.3.10.9.body: A "warm-up cycle" means sufficient vehicle operation such that the coolant temperature has risen by at least 22 K from engine starting and reaches a minimum temperature of 343 K (70 °C).

REG154.04.BODY.3.10.10.lb: 3.10.10. A "Fuel trim" refers to feedback adjustments to the base fuel schedule. Shortte…
REG154.04.BODY.3.10.10.body: A "Fuel trim" refers to feedback adjustments to the base fuel schedule. Shortterm fuel trim refers to dynamic or instantaneous adjustments. Long-term fuel trim refers to much more gradual adjustments to the fuel calibration schedule than short-term trim adjustments. These long-term adjustments compensate for vehicle differences and gradual changes that occur over time.

REG154.04.BODY.3.10.11.lb: 3.10.11. A "Calculated load value" refers to an indication of the current airflow divide…
REG154.04.BODY.3.10.11.body: A "Calculated load value" refers to an indication of the current airflow divided by peak airflow, where peak airflow is corrected for altitude, if available. This definition provides a dimensionless number that is not engine specific and provides the service technician with an indication of the proportion of engine capacity that is being used (with wide open throttle as 100 per cent); [EQ:REG154.04.BODY.3.10.11.EQ-1]

REG154.04.BODY.3.10.12.lb: 3.10.12. "Permanent emission default mode" refers to a case where the engine management …
REG154.04.BODY.3.10.12.body: "Permanent emission default mode" refers to a case where the engine management controller permanently switches to a setting that does not require an input from a failed component or system where such a failed component or system would result in an increase in emissions from the vehicle to a level above the OBD thresholds given in paragraph 6.8.2.

REG154.04.BODY.3.10.12.1.lb: 3.10.12.1. Permanent in this context means that the default mode is not recoverable, i.e. …
REG154.04.BODY.3.10.12.1.body: Permanent in this context means that the default mode is not recoverable, i.e. the diagnostic or control strategy that caused the emission default mode cannot run in the next driving cycle and cannot confirm that the conditions that caused the emission default mode is not present anymore. All other emission default modes are considered not to be permanent.

REG154.04.BODY.3.10.13.lb: 3.10.13. "Power take-off (PTO) unit" means an engine-driven output provision for the pur…
REG154.04.BODY.3.10.13.body: "Power take-off (PTO) unit" means an engine-driven output provision for the purposes of powering auxiliary, vehicle mounted, equipment.

REG154.04.BODY.3.10.14.lb: 3.10.14. "Access" means the availability of all emission-related OBD data including all …
REG154.04.BODY.3.10.14.body: "Access" means the availability of all emission-related OBD data including all fault codes required for the inspection, diagnosis, servicing or repair of emissions-related parts of the vehicle, via the serial interface for the standard diagnostic connection (pursuant to paragraph 6.5.3.5. of Appendix 1 to Annex C5).

REG154.04.BODY.3.10.15.1.lb: 3.10.15.1. Access not dependent on an access code obtainable only from the manufacturer, o…
REG154.04.BODY.3.10.15.1.body: Access not dependent on an access code obtainable only from the manufacturer, or a similar device; or

REG154.04.BODY.3.10.15.2.lb: 3.10.15.2. Access allowing evaluation of the data produced without the need for any unique…
REG154.04.BODY.3.10.15.2.body: Access allowing evaluation of the data produced without the need for any unique decoding information, unless that information itself is standardised.

REG154.04.BODY.3.10.16.lb: 3.10.16. "Standardised" means that all data stream information, including all fault code…
REG154.04.BODY.3.10.16.body: "Standardised" means that all data stream information, including all fault codes used, shall be produced only in accordance with industry standards which, by virtue of the fact that their format and their permitted options are clearly defined, provide for a maximum level of harmonisation in the motor vehicle industry, and whose use is expressly permitted in this Regulation.

REG154.04.BODY.3.10.18.lb: 3.10.18. "Deficiency" means, in respect of vehicle OBD systems, that components or syste…
REG154.04.BODY.3.10.18.body: "Deficiency" means, in respect of vehicle OBD systems, that components or systems that are monitored contain temporary or permanent operating characteristics that impair the otherwise efficient OBD monitoring of those components or systems or do not meet all of the other detailed requirements for OBD.

REG154.04.BODY.3.10.19.lb: 3.10.19. "Limp-home routines" means any default mode other than emission default mode.
REG154.04.BODY.3.10.19.body: "Limp-home routines" means any default mode other than emission default mode.

REG154.04.BODY.3.10.20.lb: 3.10.20. "Pending fault code" is a diagnostic trouble code stored upon the initial
REG154.04.BODY.3.10.20.title: "Pending fault code" is a diagnostic trouble code stored upon the initial
REG154.04.BODY.3.10.20.body: detection of a malfunction prior to illumination of the malfunction indicator.

REG154.04.BODY.3.10.21.lb: 3.10.21. "Readiness" means a status indicating whether a monitor or a group of monitors …
REG154.04.BODY.3.10.21.body: "Readiness" means a status indicating whether a monitor or a group of monitors have run since the last erasing by an external request or command (for example through an OBD scan-tool).

REG154.04.BODY.3.10.22.lb: 3.10.22. "Confirmed fault code" is defined as the diagnostic trouble code stored when th…
REG154.04.BODY.3.10.22.body: "Confirmed fault code" is defined as the diagnostic trouble code stored when the OBD system has confirmed that a malfunction exists (e.g., typically on the third driving cycle that the malfunction is detected).

REG154.04.BODY.3.10.23.lb: 3.10.23. "Cold start" means in the context of In Use Performance Ratio Monitoring (IUPR_…
REG154.04.BODY.3.10.23.body: "Cold start" means in the context of In Use Performance Ratio Monitoring (IUPR_M), an engine coolant temperature (or equivalent temperature) at engine start of less than or equal to 35 °C and less than or equal to 7 K higher than ambient temperature (if available) at engine start.

REG154.04.BODY.3.10.24.lb: 3.10.24. “Emission control components” (also called “emission control system components”…
REG154.04.BODY.3.10.24.body: “Emission control components” (also called “emission control system components”, “emission related powertrain components”, “ emission control device”, “ emission-related component”) means any component of the “emission control system” which has an influence on the emissions for which an OBD thresholds in Table 4A and Table 4B in paragraph 6.8.2. exists.

REG154.04.BODY.3.11.title: Ambient Temperature Correction Test (Annex B6a)
REG154.04.BODY.3.11.body: This paragraph is applicable to Level 1A and Level 2 only

REG154.04.BODY.3.11.1.lb: 3.11.1. "Active heat storage device" means a technology that stores heat within any dev…
REG154.04.BODY.3.11.1.body: "Active heat storage device" means a technology that stores heat within any device of a vehicle and releases the heat to a powertrain component over a defined time period at engine start. It is characterised by the stored enthalpy in the system and the time for heat release to the powertrain components.

REG154.04.BODY.3.11.2.lb: 3.11.2. "Insulation materials" means any material in the engine compartment attached to…
REG154.04.BODY.3.11.2.body: "Insulation materials" means any material in the engine compartment attached to the engine and/or the chassis with a thermal insulation effect and characterised by a maximum heat conductivity of 0.1 W/(mK).

REG154.04.BODY.3.12.1.lb: 3.12.1. "Battery" means, a rechargeable electrical energy storage system (REESS) instal…
REG154.04.BODY.3.12.1.body: "Battery" means, a rechargeable electrical energy storage system (REESS) installed in an electrified vehicle and used mainly for traction purposes.

REG154.04.BODY.3.12.2.lb: 3.12.2. "Originally installed battery" means the battery that is installed in the vehic…
REG154.04.BODY.3.12.2.body: "Originally installed battery" means the battery that is installed in the vehicle at the time of manufacture, or if the vehicle is manufactured without an installed battery, the battery that is installed in the vehicle when it is first operated on the road.

REG154.04.BODY.3.12.3.lb: 3.12.3. "Usable battery energy (UBE)" means the energy supplied by the battery from the…
REG154.04.BODY.3.12.3.body: "Usable battery energy (UBE)" means the energy supplied by the battery from the beginning of the test procedure used for certification until the applicable break-off criterion of the test procedure used for certification is reached.

REG154.04.BODY.3.12.4.lb: 3.12.4. "Certified usable battery energy" (UBEcertified) refers to the UBE that was det…
REG154.04.BODY.3.12.4.body: "Certified usable battery energy" (UBEcertified) refers to the UBE that was determined during the certification of the vehicle, according to Appendix 2 to Annex C1 of this Regulation.

REG154.04.BODY.3.12.5.lb: 3.12.5. "Measured usable battery energy" (UBE_measured) means the UBE determined at the…
REG154.04.BODY.3.12.5.body: "Measured usable battery energy" (UBE_measured) means the UBE determined at the present point in the lifetime of the vehicle by the test procedure used for certification, according to Appendix 2 to Annex C1 of this Regulation.

REG154.04.BODY.3.12.6.lb: 3.12.6. "Electric Range" in Annex C1 refers to the range that would be determined by th…
REG154.04.BODY.3.12.6.body: "Electric Range" in Annex C1 refers to the range that would be determined by the range test procedure used for certification of the vehicle, if the test was performed at the present point in the lifetime of the vehicle and with the originally installed battery.

REG154.04.BODY.3.12.7.lb: 3.12.7. "Certified range" (Rangecertified) refers to the electric driving range that wa…
REG154.04.BODY.3.12.7.body: "Certified range" (Rangecertified) refers to the electric driving range that was determined during certification of the vehicle, according to Appendix 2 to Annex C1 of this Regulation.

REG154.04.BODY.3.12.8.lb: 3.12.8. "Measured range" (Rangemeasured) means the electric range determined at the pre…
REG154.04.BODY.3.12.8.body: "Measured range" (Rangemeasured) means the electric range determined at the present point in the lifetime of the vehicle by the test procedure used for certification, according to Appendix 2 to Annex C1 of this Regulation.

REG154.04.BODY.3.12.9.lb: 3.12.9. "State of certified energy" (SOCE) means the durability performance of the batt…
REG154.04.BODY.3.12.9.body: "State of certified energy" (SOCE) means the durability performance of the battery at a specific point in the lifetime of the vehicle, determined as a measured or estimated usable battery energy divided by the certified usable battery energy, and expressed as a percentage..

REG154.04.BODY.3.12.10.lb: 3.12.10. "State of certified range" (SOCR) means the measured or on-board electric range…
REG154.04.BODY.3.12.10.body: "State of certified range" (SOCR) means the measured or on-board electric range at a specific point in its lifetime, expressed as a percentage of the certified range.

REG154.04.BODY.3.12.11.lb: 3.12.11. "Minimum Performance Requirement" (MPR) means the minimum durability performanc…
REG154.04.BODY.3.12.11.body: "Minimum Performance Requirement" (MPR) means the minimum durability performance, in terms of SOCE or SOCR at a specific point in the lifetime of the vehicle, that constitutes compliance with the durability provisions of this Regulation.

REG154.04.BODY.3.12.12.lb: 3.12.12. "Declared Performance Requirement" (DPR) means an SOCE or SOCR value declared b…
REG154.04.BODY.3.12.12.body: "Declared Performance Requirement" (DPR) means an SOCE or SOCR value declared by the manufacturer that is greater than that of the corresponding MPR and which then becomes the minimum durability performance that constitutes compliance of that manufacturer with the durability provisions of this Regulation.

REG154.04.BODY.3.12.13.lb: 3.12.13. "SOCR monitor" means an apparatus installed in the vehicle that maintains an es…
REG154.04.BODY.3.12.13.body: "SOCR monitor" means an apparatus installed in the vehicle that maintains an estimate of the state of certified range by means of an algorithm operating on data collected from the vehicle systems.

REG154.04.BODY.3.12.14.lb: 3.12.14. "SOCE monitor" means an apparatus installed in the vehicle that maintains an es…
REG154.04.BODY.3.12.14.body: "SOCE monitor" means an apparatus installed in the vehicle that maintains an estimate of the state of certified energy by means of an algorithm operating on data collected from the vehicle systems.

REG154.04.BODY.3.12.15.lb: 3.12.15. "On-board SOCR” (SOCR_read) means an estimate of state of certified range produ…
REG154.04.BODY.3.12.15.body: "On-board SOCR” (SOCR_read) means an estimate of state of certified range produced by an SOCR monitor.

REG154.04.BODY.3.12.16.lb: 3.12.16. "On-board SOCE" (SOCE_read) means an estimate of state of certified energy prod…
REG154.04.BODY.3.12.16.body: "On-board SOCE" (SOCE_read) means an estimate of state of certified energy produced by an SOCE monitor.

REG154.04.BODY.3.12.17.lb: 3.12.17. "Measured SOCR" (SOCR_measured) means the state of certified range as determine…
REG154.04.BODY.3.12.17.body: "Measured SOCR" (SOCR_measured) means the state of certified range as determined by the measured range divided by the certified range, according to paragraph 3.1.2. of Annex 5 of UN Regulation No. 83.

REG154.04.BODY.3.12.18.lb: 3.12.18. "Measured SOCE" means the state of certified energy as determined by the measur…
REG154.04.BODY.3.12.18.body: "Measured SOCE" means the state of certified energy as determined by the measured usable battery energy divided by the certified usable battery energy.

REG154.04.BODY.3.12.19.lb: 3.12.19. "V2X" means the use of the traction batteries to cover external power and energ…
REG154.04.BODY.3.12.19.body: "V2X" means the use of the traction batteries to cover external power and energy demand, such as V2G (Vehicle-to-Grid) for grid stabilization by utilising traction batteries, V2H (Vehicle-to-Home) for utilizing traction batteries as residential storage for local optimisation or emergency power sources in times of power failure, and V2L (Vehicle-to-Load, only connected loads are supplied) for use in times of power failure and/or outdoor activity in normal times.

REG154.04.BODY.3.12.20.lb: 3.12.20. "Total discharge energy during V2X" means the total amount of discharged energy…
REG154.04.BODY.3.12.20.body: "Total discharge energy during V2X" means the total amount of discharged energy during V2X which needs to be provided according to Appendix 1 to Annex C1 of this Regulation.

REG154.04.BODY.3.12.21.lb: 3.12.21. "Maximum charging power" means the highest available charging power for the con…
REG154.04.BODY.3.12.21.body: "Maximum charging power" means the highest available charging power for the considered Part B family, as defined in paragraph 6.11.1.2. of this Regulation.

REG154.04.BODY.3.12.22.lb: 3.12.22. "Energy throughput " means the total amount of energy in kWh discharged from th…
REG154.04.BODY.3.12.22.body: "Energy throughput " means the total amount of energy in kWh discharged from the battery.

REG154.04.BODY.3.12.23.lb: 3.12.23. "Total discharge energy for non-traction purposes" means the total amount of en…
REG154.04.BODY.3.12.23.body: "Total discharge energy for non-traction purposes" means the total amount of energy in kWh discharged from the battery for purposes other than traction to support the particular use case of a Category N vehicle and do not include air conditioning/heating for the cabin or other uses already present in category M.

REG154.04.BODY.3.12.24.lb: 3.12.24. "Odometer" means an instrument which indicates to the driver the total distance…
REG154.04.BODY.3.12.24.body: "Odometer" means an instrument which indicates to the driver the total distance recorded by the vehicle since its production.

REG154.04.BODY.3.12.25.lb: 3.12.25. "State of charge (SOC)" means the indicated value of the residual capacity in a…
REG154.04.BODY.3.12.25.body: "State of charge (SOC)" means the indicated value of the residual capacity in a battery available to be discharged expressed as a percentage and as indicated to the vehicle operator.

REG154.04.BODY.4.1.lb: 4.1. The application for approval of a vehicle type with regard to the requirements …
REG154.04.BODY.4.1.body: The application for approval of a vehicle type with regard to the requirements of this Regulation shall be submitted to the Type Approval Authority by the vehicle manufacturer or by their authorized representative, who is any natural or legal person who is duly appointed by the manufacturer to represent him before the approval authority and to act on his behalf in matters covered by this Regulation.

REG154.04.BODY.4.1.1.lb: 4.1.1. The application referred to in paragraph 4.1. shall be drawn up in accordance w…
REG154.04.BODY.4.1.1.body: The application referred to in paragraph 4.1. shall be drawn up in accordance with the model of the information document set out in Annex A1 to this Regulation.

REG154.04.BODY.4.1.2.lb: 4.1.2. In addition, the manufacturer shall submit the following information: (a) In th…
REG154.04.BODY.4.1.2.body: In addition, the manufacturer shall submit the following information: (a) In the case of vehicles equipped with positive ignition engines, a declaration by the manufacturer of the minimum percentage of misfires out of a total number of firing events that would either result in emissions exceeding the OBD thresholds given in para graph 6.8.2., if that percentage of misfire had been present from the start of a Type 1 test as chosen for the demonstration in accordance with Annex C5, or that could lead to an exhaust catalyst, or catalysts, overheating prior to causing irreversible damage; (b) A description of the malfunction indicator used by the OBD system to signal the presence of a fault to a driver of the vehicle; (c) For Level 1B and Level 2 only: A description of the provisions taken to prevent tampering with and modification of the emission control computer; (d) For Level 1B and Level 2 only: If applicable, the particulars of the OBD family as referred to in paragraph 6.8.1.; (e) For Level 1A and 4-phase WLTP in Level 2 only: Manufacturer’s declarations of compliance covering the following topics, if applicable: (i) Reagent requirements (Annex A2 Appendix 1); (ii) Ambient Temperature Correction Test (ATCT) (Annex A2 Appendix 2); (iii) Regeneration requirements (Annex A2 Appendix 3); (iv) Durability for emissions (Type 5 test) (Annex A2 Appendix 4); (v) OBD requirements (Annex A2 Appendix 5) (vi) Battery durability (Annex A2 Appendix 6)

REG154.04.BODY.4.1.3.lb: 4.1.3. For Level 1B and Level 2 only: For the tests described in paragraph 3. of Annex…
REG154.04.BODY.4.1.3.body: For Level 1B and Level 2 only: For the tests described in paragraph 3. of Annex C5 to this Regulation, a vehicle representative of the vehicle type or vehicle family fitted with the OBD system to be approved shall be submitted to the Technical Service responsible for the type approval test. If the Technical Service determines that the submitted vehicle does not fully represent the OBD family described in paragraph 6.8.1., an alternative and, if necessary, an additional vehicle shall be submitted for test in accordance with paragraph 3. of Annex C5 to this Regulation.

REG154.04.BODY.4.2.lb: 4.2. A model of the information document relating to exhaust emissions, emissions of…
REG154.04.BODY.4.2.body: A model of the information document relating to exhaust emissions, emissions of carbon dioxide and fuel consumption and/or the measurement of electric energy consumption and electric range, evaporative emissions, durability and OBD, is given in Annex A1 to this Regulation.

REG154.04.BODY.4.2.1.lb: 4.2.1. Where appropriate, copies of other type approvals with the relevant data to ena…
REG154.04.BODY.4.2.1.body: Where appropriate, copies of other type approvals with the relevant data to enable extensions of approvals and establishment of deterioration factors shall be submitted.

REG154.04.BODY.4.3.lb: 4.3. For the tests specified in Table A in paragraph 6. a vehicle representative of …
REG154.04.BODY.4.3.body: For the tests specified in Table A in paragraph 6. a vehicle representative of the vehicle type to be approved shall be submitted to the Technical Service responsible for the approval tests.

REG154.04.BODY.4.3.2.lb: 4.3.2. For the purposes of subparagraphs 4.1.2. (b), Type Approval Authorities shall n…
REG154.04.BODY.4.3.2.body: For the purposes of subparagraphs 4.1.2. (b), Type Approval Authorities shall not approve a vehicle if the information submitted by the manufacturer is inappropriate for fulfilling the requirements of paragraph 7. of Appendix 1 to Annex C5 to this Regulation. Paragraphs 7.2., 7.3. and 7.7. of Appendix 1 to Annex C5 to this Regulation shall apply under all reasonably foreseeable driving conditions. For the assessment of the implementation of the requirements set out in the paragraphs 7.2. and 7.3. of Appendix 1 to Annex C5, the Type Approval Authority shall take into account the state of technology.

REG154.04.BODY.4.3.3.lb: 4.3.3. This paragraph is applicable to Level 1B and Level 2 only
REG154.04.BODY.4.3.3.title: This paragraph is applicable to Level 1B and Level 2 only
REG154.04.BODY.4.3.3.body: For the purposes of paragraph 4.1.2. (c), the provisions taken to prevent tampering with and modification of the emission control computer shall include the facility for updating using a manufacturer-approved programme or calibration.

REG154.04.BODY.4.3.4.lb: 4.3.4. The application for type approval of flex-fuel, mono fuel, and bi-fuel vehicles…
REG154.04.BODY.4.3.4.body: The application for type approval of flex-fuel, mono fuel, and bi-fuel vehicles shall comply with the additional requirements laid down in paragraphs 5.8. and

REG154.04.BODY.5.9.lb: 5.9. Additional requirements for mono fuel gas vehicles, and bi-fuel gas vehicles.
REG154.04.BODY.5.9.body: Additional requirements for mono fuel gas vehicles, and bi-fuel gas vehicles.

REG154.04.BODY.4.3.5.lb: 4.3.5. Changes to the make of a system, component or separate technical unit that occu…
REG154.04.BODY.4.3.5.body: Changes to the make of a system, component or separate technical unit that occur after a type approval shall not automatically invalidate a type approval, unless its original characteristics or technical parameters are changed in such a way that the functionality of the engine or pollution control system is affected or the battery durability of the vehicle is adversely affected.

REG154.04.BODY.4.4.lb: 4.4. The Type Approval Authority shall verify the existence of satisfactory provisio…
REG154.04.BODY.4.4.body: The Type Approval Authority shall verify the existence of satisfactory provisions to ensure an effective check of conformity of production before approval of the vehicle type is granted.

REG154.04.BODY.4.5.lb: 4.5. This paragraph is applicable for Level 1A only
REG154.04.BODY.4.5.title: This paragraph is applicable for Level 1A only
REG154.04.BODY.4.5.body: For vehicle types with an existing valid type-approval issued in accordance with the series of amendments 02 or 03 this Regulation and for which a manufacturer requests an emission type-approval in order to designate new vehicles to be compliant to the emission standards, as specified in Tables 1A and 1B of paragraph 6.3.10. to this Regulation, new type-approval testing shall not be required if: (a) the manufacturer declares to the granting type-approval authority that compliance with the requirements of this Regulation is ensured; and (b) the technical service responsible for the testing agrees that the previous type-approved test results can be used for the preparation of a new emission test report to demonstrate compliance to the requirements oof this series of amendments.

REG154.04.BODY.5.1.lb: 5.1. If the vehicle type submitted for approval meets all the relevant requirements
REG154.04.BODY.5.1.title: If the vehicle type submitted for approval meets all the relevant requirements

REG154.04.BODY.5.2.lb: 5.2. An approval number shall be assigned to each type approved.
REG154.04.BODY.5.2.body: An approval number shall be assigned to each type approved.

REG154.04.BODY.5.2.1.lb: 5.2.1. The type approval number shall consist of four sections. Each section shall be …
REG154.04.BODY.5.2.1.body: The type approval number shall consist of four sections. Each section shall be separated by the '*' character. Section 1: The capital letter 'E' followed by the distinguishing number of the Contracting Party which has granted the type approval2F. Section 2: The number 154, followed by the letter 'R', successively followed by: (a) Two digits (with leading zeros as applicable) indicating the series of amendments incorporating the technical provisions of the UN Regulation applied to the approval (00 for the UN Regulation in its original form); (b) A slash (/) and two digits (with leading zeros as applicable) indicating the number of supplement to the series of amendments applied to the approval (00 for the series of amendments in its original form); (c) A slash (/) and two character(s) indicating the implementing stage/level (e.g. 1A, 1B, 02). Section 3: A four-digit sequential number (with leading zeros as applicable). The sequence shall start from 0001. Section 4: A two-digit sequential number (with leading zeros if applicable) to denote the extension. The sequence shall start from 00. All digits shall be Arabic digits.
